F12_closure.owned_sequence: Stable IDs are assigned in complete current argument, BB, instruction layout order. The projection has total value count and per-value use count followed by ordered userID/operandNo pairs, distinguishing empty lists, boundaries and order without addresses. Counts are range-checked. Foreign/non-instruction users reject projection.
F12_closure.subject: eligibleFunction requires valid actual naming map and owned sequence. FunctionText appends the binary resident sequence; subject entry/output compare both carry it. Existing local-use restoration from bitcode/current clone remains and output comparison now checks the restored actual sequence.
F12_closure.caller: Every actual direct caller must belong to current module, have valid current naming state and pass the same owned-sequence schema before the subject is admitted. Unrepresentable caller cannot produce an accepted shared empty functionText key. Header/world and explicit subject incoming-use order remain separately bound.
F12_closure.hidden_blockaddress: Every owned BB explicitly rejects hasAddressTaken. In LLVM23 BlockAddress stores a private BB pointer and zero Use operands, so ordinary owned-use traversal alone is insufficient. The new gate applies equally to subject and caller; test preserves the initial admissible caller then rejects both distinct hidden-address callers.
F12_closure.machine_input: MIR inputDomain uses the same eligibleFunction; machine input/current capture uses the same functionText. Thus the same local-use omission is closed on that actual native-consumer path.
F12_closure.counterexample: Root full12 runs the genuine reversed-use-order example: official Function::print(true) stays equal, new key differs, reversing back restores exact key. Caller hidden-address rejection test also passes. This is dependency differentiation, not a claimed end-to-end executable divergence experiment.
F12_closure.historical_failure: Full11 54 pass/1 fail is retained. Its negative expected BlockAddress to appear in BB.uses; new explicit hasAddressTaken gate fixes the production omission and the unchanged strict expected-success assertion passes in full12.

raw_probability_closure.helper: Same fixed DSO pure const getter checks requested Count==private Probs.size and non-null output for nonzero count before any write. It copies exact uint32 numerator values including UnknownN, no normalization/query mutation and no layout/vtable change. Null IR and wrong count reject without partial output writes.
raw_probability_closure.consumer: Typed capture stores has-probabilities separately and requests the exact raw vector size; restores ordered successors using BranchProbability::getRaw and addSuccessor, or addSuccessorWithoutProb for absent vector. Actual typed recapture re-reads the exact raw vector and compares full body state.
raw_probability_closure.tests: Existing typed scratch mask now includes single unknown edge whose effective answer is one yet raw sentinel must survive, successor-with-empty-probability-vector, and null/wrong-count output sentinel preservation. Original ownership/reconstruction/flags/ties/masks and full MIR equality/verifier remain.
raw_probability_closure.remaining: No fallback to an effective-only quotient; absent helper makes capture ineligible. Optional cache limits are logical payload bounds, not RSS.
